rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR THORACIC SPINE MRI / Evaluation of Neurologic Deficits (1)

criteria.description: Patient has objective physical exam findings of thoracic myelopathy or sensory/motor level deficit

required_documentation: Neurological physical examination documenting motor weakness, sensory level, hyperreflexia, or spastic gait
rules.review_notes: Thoracic MRI first-line imaging for thoracic myelopathy and cord compression deficits.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR THORACIC SPINE MRI / Evaluation of Back Pain (1) / Pain lasting > 4 weeks

criteria.description: Thoracic back pain lasting greater than 4 weeks
Failure of at least 4-6 weeks of conservative management (e.g. physical therapy, chiropractic treatments, home exercise program)

required_documentation: Physical therapy notes or physician progress notes verifying duration of pain and conservative management regimen
rules.review_notes: Thoracic MRI for uncomplicated thoracic pain after conservative therapy.
